source: TOPIK II — questions added one at a time, from the papers the player brings
title: TOPIK II

level.name: 토픽 II 준비
level.description: Farm the words the exam questions bring in, and work the questions at the desk.
level.descriptionEn: A practice world for TOPIK II, band 3-4급. Unlike the textbook units this one has no fixed chapter: questions arrive one at a time and the word list grows out of them. Words already taught elsewhere are kept here too — this is a study room, not a syllabus, and a word you meet in an exam question belongs in the exam room whether or not you first met it on a farm.
